examples.text: The quality entry has tga:1, which shows it as messaging TX every run; the workflow and CLAUDE.md say only on a problem (hollow plane), so remove tga.
Step 1 output block lists exact tiktoken ids that were not verified and may be invented; run the snippet and paste real output, or drop the ids.
The Common errors card covers Flask not installed and port 5000 in use, but this lesson has no Flask or server; remove it or use an error the lesson can cause.
The improve job checks out with persist-credentials: false, so git push -u origin has no credentials and the run will fail at the push.
A duplicated script line (tracks.js, build-concepts.js, site.js) was added above the existing one, and the page check fails on stale ?v= hashes; remove it and r
Code box labels say queue.py and decide.py but the code is backend.py and agent.py, and Step 6 imports those names; use data-file="backend.py" and "agent.py".
The quality agent is in AGENTS but has no node in N or the phone layer list L, so its popup and status can never be opened on desktop or phone.
Local check output (quality-out/links.json and links.md) was committed; the json is not in .vercelignore so it would be served live. Delete both and ignore qual
